text: The browser tests distinguish test_primaryPasswordRefused from test_osAuthRefused and assert "Should remain at start" after the prompt promise completes. For this flow, use a separate negative-path case for each authentication mechanism and assert the state that must remain, not only that the prompt closed. These descriptive task names are a local test pattern, not a rule requiring snake_case for all Thunderbird tests. Source was inspected; neither authentication path was run here. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: QR refusal tests name each authentication path and assert no forward transition
